narrative.overview:
Every shipped project is a white scale model standing on one plinth in a dark gallery, under a single warm raking spotlight. The site is that room. The walls are near-black (gallery), the light is warm (lamplight, used only as a soft wash from above), and the models are white card and basswood. Tiny coral human figures stand among the models: they are the people each project amplifies, and coral belongs to them, to the logo dot and to the action the visitor should take next.

The homepage hero is a real-time React Three Fiber maquette (`site/src/components/stage/Scene.tsx`). Three models stand on a near-black plinth over a warm basswood-brown floor. Each one shows its real product screenshot as a lit screen, and black museum placards hang on the plinth front. Everything below the hero borrows from that room. Screenshots hang as framed prints. Labels and offers sit on black placards. Lists are wall labels divided by hairlines instead of boxed cards. Headlines are heavy white grotesk set at monumental scale with tight tracking. Density is low and the rhythm generous: sections breathe at up to 184px, and the copy rarely runs past 60–68ch.

The world refuses the AI-agency default: a dark field with neon glow, a bento grid, glass cards and gradient text. It also refuses showreel-over-video. MOTION.md, style-guide.md and the visual parts of writing-guide.md at the repo root describe the **previous** world (Inter, coral gradient text, glassmorphic cards, a dot-grid shader, a cyan secondary). That world has been replaced, and those files do not govern v3 visuals. Voice and copy rules in writing-guide.md still apply: active voice, specific numbers, no fluff, action-led CTAs, and its word-choice and sentence-length guidance. Two of its sections do not carry over: "Section Labels" (small uppercase labels above headlines) and the hero rule that the "middle word gets gradient treatment".
keyCharacteristics: One dark room with one warm light. All atmosphere comes from a lamplight wash from above.
Coral marks the human figures, the logo dot and actions, and nothing decorative.
Black placards are the labelling device, with a condensed italic caption face for their titles.
Screenshots are always framed exhibits: a black moulding, a dark mat and a warm top bounce.
Square corners everywhere. Only the logo dot and avatars are round.
Heavy white grotesk headlines with negative tracking and leading under 1.

rules.name: The Coral Is Human Rule
rules.body: Coral fills only the human figures, the logo dot and actions, and it colours only interaction states (hover, focus, selection, current). It never appears in a gradient, a glow, a background wash, a border ornament or an illustration other than the figures.

rules.name: The One Warm Light Rule
rules.body: All atmosphere is one warm light from above: radial washes of lamplight at 0.16 alpha or less, anchored at the top edge. Coloured glows, neon and cool light in the interface are out. The scene's single cool fill (`#9aa6c8` at 0.5) is a bounce panel inside the 3D environment only.

rules.name: The Monumental Grotesk Rule
rules.body: Headlines are Golos Text 700 with negative tracking (−0.03 to −0.04em) and leading under 1. Light or regular weights never set a headline.

rules.name: The Caption Face Rule
rules.body: Barlow Condensed italic labels things: placards, sequence numbers, tags and metadata. It never sets a headline, body copy or a button.

rules.name: The Lit From Above Rule
rules.body: Every cast shadow falls downward (positive y, blur at least 18px), and any warm light sits on the top edge. Coloured or upward shadows are not used.

dos: **Do** put every real screenshot in a framed exhibit (moulding, mat, warm top bounce). Never show it as a bare image.
**Do** use placard-black placards for labels, offers, forms and stat bands, with square corners and a downward shadow.
**Do** divide lists with hairlines (`hairline-rule` on top, `hairline-row` between rows) and start included items with a 10–12px basswood dash.
**Do** set headlines in Golos Text 700 with −0.03 to −0.04em tracking and leading of 0.82–0.98.
**Do** keep coral to the figures, the logo dot, action fills and interaction states, with coral-press for hover.
**Do** light sections only with lamplight radial washes from the top edge at 0.16 alpha or less.
**Do** use 160ms ease-out for colour changes and cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) at 240–320ms for lifts and reveals, and honour `prefers-reduced-motion`.
donts: **Don't** put an eyebrow or kicker (a small uppercase or italic category line) above a headline. The writing-guide's "Section Labels" pattern belongs to the previous world.
**Don't** use gradient text, glassmorphic cards, neon or coloured glows, bento grids or the dot-grid shader from the legacy style-guide.md and MOTION.md.
**Don't** round corners on buttons, placards, frames or inputs.
**Don't** box list items into individual cards when a hairline list will do.
**Don't** use coral for decoration, backgrounds, gradients or illustration other than the human figures.
**Don't** use white card or basswood as large interface fills. They are model materials, and basswood appears in the interface only as small ornament.
**Don't** use glowing brains, robots or circuit-board imagery.
